scenarios.label: bull
scenarios.drivers: Gross margin snaps back toward FY25 levels as data centers hit full contracted revenue; mega-customer RPO conversion runs ~15% above current run-rate with no pullback; market re-rates toward the own-history NTM mean multiple (14.71x).

scenarios.label: base
scenarios.multiple_basis: NTM EV/EBITDA (implied by the 40/40/20 weighted blend of 02/03/04, not independently applied)
scenarios.drivers: Consensus NTM EBITDA is roughly achieved, but the market continues to price Oracle's leverage (net debt/EBITDA 4.46x) and eroding return on capital at a discount to its own recent multiple and to peers — no further de-rating, no re-rating.

scenarios.label: bear_cyclical
scenarios.metric_basis: NTM (FY2027) EBITDA, customer-concentration pullback + further gross-margin compression
scenarios.multiple_basis: NTM EV/EBITDA (compressed to the own-history 5yr band floor)
scenarios.drivers: A 12-month, print-driven demand shock: one of the four >$8bn named AI-infrastructure customers cuts contracted RPO ~20%, and the FY27 gross-margin step-down management has already flagged lands harder than guided.

scenarios.label: bear_structural
scenarios.metric_basis: 24-36 month structural reset — declining-perpetuity (impaired FCFF) DCF, not a metric x multiple construction
scenarios.drivers: Moat erosion (ROIC below WACC, 4 straight years) does not stabilize: OCI never reaches AWS/Azure-level scale or switching-cost economics and becomes fully commoditized, while the shrinking legacy annuity — the one segment with a real moat — cannot offset the loss.

stated_drivers.label: terminal EBIT margin
stated_drivers.note: below Oracle's own FY23 GAAP trough of 27.4% — full moat erosion / commoditized OCI scenario

stated_drivers.label: terminal ROIC
stated_drivers.note: below WACC (9.96%) — value-destructive reinvestment, not merely at cost of capital

stated_drivers.label: terminal growth g
stated_drivers.note: nominal, at/below current US inflation — a fading, non-recovering trajectory

sotp_segments.segment: Consolidated (collapsed proxy for Cloud & Software, 90.7% of FY26 segment profit)
sotp_segments.comp: SAP SE / Microsoft Corp average NTM EV/EBITDA
